deadline.intake: 2027 entry, SPSF first application period (first-year entry; 11 Nov - 4 Dec 2026); second period 10-31 Mar 2027

tuition.note: Two semesters at 696,000 JPY each (Faculty of Science and Technology DGTech, AY 2027); plus 200,000 JPY entrance fee once

requirement.text: SPSF applicants submit one or more of SAT, ACT, IB Diploma or UK GCE/International A-level results, a high school transcript, certificate of graduation, two recommendation letters and an essay, plus TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic.
